title: HomeworkDefaults
description: course/assessments/homework-defaults.yaml — the teacher's learned homework defaults (homework module, HW-D16). Read by homework-planner and the /create-homework interviewer; updated at Gate 2 approval. Optional: created by the first /create-homework (HW-D13). Cross-file checks (class mix sums to ~1.0, classes exist) are the rule `homework_defaults_consistent`, not this schema.

total_minutes.description: Default time budget for a homework, in minutes. Same bound as the manifest's `total_minutes`.

default_class_mix.description: Proportion of items per Item Class in a typical homework. Keys are class names from item-classes.yaml; values sum to ~1.0 (checked by `homework_defaults_consistent`). A class added with /new-hw-type starts at 0.

allowed_tools.description: Default tools, by key from course.yaml's `tools` map (HW-D03).

answer_release.description: Default only. A graded homework may still not use `with_homework` (`graded_answer_release_safe`).

reuse_policy.description: never = always fresh items; practice = reuse only for practice homework; always = reuse for any purpose.

budget_tolerance_minutes.description: How far the sum of item minutes may drift from `total_minutes` before `homework_budget_fits` warns.
